exposure: deaf and hard of hearing (DHH) status
cohort: The study included deliveries to deaf and hard of hearing women and non-deaf and hard of hearing women from the 2007-2016 Healthcare Cost and Utilization Project National Inpatient Sample.
finding: Deaf and hard of hearing women faced an increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcomes and chronic medical conditions, including a variety of specific complications, compared to non-deaf and hard of hearing women.
mod_finding: Deaf and hard of hearing women had an increased risk of cesarean delivery.
